title: A weekly phase from 1984-2004 gave no clear positive transfer to Geysers M2+ earthquakes in 2005-2025
abstract: We tested whether an early weekly phase repeated in later Geysers earthquake counts. We fitted an exposure-adjusted weekly harmonic on M2+ ComCat events in 1984-2004, then fixed its phase for 2005-2025. The later projection was -3.87%, with a conditional 95% year interval of -8.33% to +0.79%. Circular month shifts gave a two-sided p value of 0.0766. Coso, Salton Sea, higher-magnitude, civil-date and year-shift checks also gave intervals that included zero. The result gives no clear positive phase transfer. It does not show the absence of weekly physical forcing. A weak early phase, detection changes, clustered events and no daily operation data limit inference. Original code, coarse evidence, source hashes, a figure and a scalar arithmetic audit are included. External raw records stay outside the package.

display.caption: Weekday rates and later-period harmonic projections along fixed early phases. Intervals use test-year resampling and condition on the early phase.
